title: Haryana Employees Cashless Health Scheme (ECHS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Cashless healthcare pathway for eligible Haryana government employees and pensioners under the state employee health framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Haryana government employees, pensioners and covered dependants according to current state rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Haryana Employees Cashless Health Scheme (ECHS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
